decision: Do not add the index based on this evidence. The two paired results disagree in direction and overlap materially; the apparent second-pair gain is within fixture/cache/system noise. The measured index added 327680 bytes on a roughly 2 MiB fixture, and production write amplification has not been measured.
limitations: This is a 20k-file synthetic microbenchmark, not the 1.8M-path production-shaped database or a cold-cache test.
Python sqlite3 uses SQLite 3.45.1; Dux's bundled/runtime SQLite configuration may differ.
The full accounting predicate was checked for valid fixture state only; no corruption mutations were part of this benchmark.

A separate 100k-path fixture-generation attempt failed the initial expected-valid predicate and was discarded; it is not a product-test failure or a passing benchmark, and the fixture generator error remains unidentified.
No production code, schema, package, service, or database was modified.
next_step: If pursuing this optimization, repeat on a consistent disposable copy of the production-shaped database with interleaved warm/cold measurements, injected corruption cases, index build/storage cost, and write-heavy scan overhead.
